name: Grape King Bio Ltd
summary: Grape King Bio Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells pharmaceutical preparations, patent medicines, liquid tonics, drinks, and healthy food in Taiwan, China, and internationally. It operates through Multi-Level Marketing; Distributors; Original Design Manufacturer/Original Equipment Manufacturer; and Sales Channel segments. The company provides health products and supplements; and microbial fermentation for mushroom mycelium, probiotics, and enzymes. It also offers functional ingredients for intestinal care, immunity regulation, liver care, brain health, eye care, weight control, feminine health, sensual health care, and others.
